achievements: Spearheaded an embeddable React chat widget across 480+ client sites, influencing $1.2M+ ARR with iframe isolation, Webpack scoping, Express BFF, and WebSocket messaging.
Led micro-frontend migration with Webpack Module Federation, removing deployment bottlenecks and reshaping monolithic UI into scalable multi-tab architecture.
Architected schema-driven Next.js survey flows with Zustand, Zod, and React Compiler-aware state patterns, reducing custom form deployment time by 20%.
Drove SEO pages into top 5 Google rankings by meeting strict Core Web Vitals targets and cutting JS payload through SSR tuning, lazy loading, code splitting, and asset optimization.
Architected Statsig-based A/B experiments and Reels-style discovery, lifting user traction from 28% to 42% across seller journeys.
Built Razorpay checkout architectures and Playwright E2E suites across 4 service flows processing 1,000+ daily transactions.
Built a zero-to-one production CRM in under 2 months using React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and Material UI for sales operations.
Engineered real-time lead communication tracking with WebSockets, Kaleyra, and REST APIs for 2000+ daily operations users.
Centralized React UI patterns across scheduling, calendar, and content modules, removing 30% redundant code.
